title: Om Ganesha
summary:
Dear friends, Loving souls,

Great News for our Electronic Mantra fans out there, we present you ... OM Ganesha. A powerful mantra that takes away obstacles and provides a safe journey while traveling or safety and good luck with new beginnings! So, we hope YOU are starting something new, be the change, be safe and SHINE!

Blessings, Haleen
lyrics
OM Gam Ganapataye Namaha
Ganesha Share Nam

OM Ganesha OM Ganapati
OM Ganesha OM Gam Ganapati
credits
from The Sacred Temple, track released January 21, 2024
Composers - Hans De Bruck / Kathleen Merckx
